## Source and method

- https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers

Every latest-version entry in the official MCP Registry (https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers, read page by page on 2026-10-17) whose registry name, title or description matches a health or fitness data-source term on a word boundary; the terms, and the four vendor names that also need a health or fitness word in the entry, are listed in src/data/mcpHealthServers.ts. Name, title, description, version, status, dates, packages, remotes, repository and website are copied from the registry entry unchanged; registry descriptions are the publishers' words. Two columns are DERIVED and keep their evidence: matchedTerms (the term and the field it matched in) and publisherIsVendor, which is yes only when the registry namespace is the reverse-DNS form of a domain this site cites for that vendor's developer documentation, with the reasoning in publisherEvidence. Package version, licence and publish date come from npm and PyPI for npm and PyPI packages only; packageNotFound lists package names those registries answered 404 for. Repositories were not read and no server was run.

## Fields

| Field | Description | JSON types | Null in |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | The registry name, namespace/server | string | 0 of 176 rows |
| `title` | The registry title; null where the entry has none | null, string | 65 of 176 rows |
| `description` | The registry description, verbatim | string | 0 of 176 rows |
| `version` | The latest version the registry lists | string | 0 of 176 rows |
| `status` | The registry's status for that version: active, deprecated or deleted | string | 0 of 176 rows |
| `registryPublishedOn` | The registry's publishedAt for that version's record, YYYY-MM-DD | string | 0 of 176 rows |
| `registryUpdatedOn` | The registry's updatedAt for that version's record, YYYY-MM-DD | string | 0 of 176 rows |
| `group` | The one group the server is listed under on the page | string | 0 of 176 rows |
| `dataSources` | Every data source a matched term names | string | 0 of 176 rows |
| `matchedTerms` | DERIVED: each matched term and the field it matched in | string | 0 of 176 rows |
| `publisherIsVendor` | DERIVED: yes only when the namespace is the vendor's own domain in reverse-DNS form | string | 0 of 176 rows |
| `publisherEvidence` | Why publisherIsVendor is yes; null otherwise | null | 176 of 176 rows |
| `packages` | Each package as listed: registry type, identifier, pinned version, transport | null, string | 89 of 176 rows |
| `remotes` | Each remote as listed: transport type and URL | null, string | 85 of 176 rows |
| `secretInputs` | Names (never values) of the environment variables, headers and URL placeholders the entry marks isSecret | null, string | 115 of 176 rows |
| `packageLatestVersion` | npm or PyPI latest version per package | null, string | 99 of 176 rows |
| `packageLastPublished` | npm or PyPI publish date of that version per package | null, string | 99 of 176 rows |
| `packageLicense` | The licence the npm or PyPI metadata states, per package | null, string | 101 of 176 rows |
| `packageNotFound` | Packages npm or PyPI answered 404 for | null, string | 175 of 176 rows |
| `repositoryUrl` | The repository URL as the entry lists it (not read) | null, string | 49 of 176 rows |
| `websiteUrl` | The website URL as the entry lists it | null, string | 69 of 176 rows |
| `registryRecord` | The registry API record the row was read from | string | 0 of 176 rows |
| `page` | This site's row for the server | string | 0 of 176 rows |

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/mcpHealthServers.ts` is generated by `scripts/fetch-mcp-health-servers.mjs` from the sources above, last read 2026-10-17.
- `.github/workflows/mcp-health-servers.yml` runs it on the schedule `13 5 * * 3` (cron, UTC).
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
